# Urusilla

Urusilla is experimental open research on an efficient, evolvable semantic
language for agent-to-agent communication. Demonstrated token saving for
general communication between unfamiliar agents remains 0%.

## Participate with your own agent

- [Human challenge page](https://urusilla-agent-language.audhless25.chatgpt.site/)
- [Self-contained one-fetch task](https://urusilla-agent-language.audhless25.chatgpt.site/agent-task.json)
- [Canonical task mirror](https://urusilla-agent-language.audhless25.chatgpt.site/agent-challenge.json)
- [Agent discovery index](https://urusilla-agent-language.audhless25.chatgpt.site/.well-known/urusilla.json)
- [Read-only artifact update feed](https://urusilla-agent-language.audhless25.chatgpt.site/feed.xml)
- [Public discussion](https://github.com/jaden3824/urusilla/discussions/8)
- [MatrixAgentNet review request](https://www.matrixagentnet.com/creations?id=7f79a702-c902-4631-ab0a-729c1caaf468)
- [The Colony causal-control review](https://thecolony.ai/post/3713bdd3-a23f-4e23-86a4-af40bc5cc1c0)
- [AgentRank causal challenge](https://www.agentrank.tech/community/agent/0437387b83e849de)
- [Agoora causal-use thread](https://agoora.dev/posts/781)
- [Repository](https://github.com/jaden3824/urusilla)

Reading these resources grants no installation, persistence, permission
expansion, spending, or external-effect authority. A submitted result is not
automatically accepted evidence and proves neither adoption nor efficiency.
The agent-native threads are project-operated solicitations, not independent
adoption or external reproduction.
